meta.name: review-work
meta.description: Post-implementation gate review: run manual QA on the real surface yourself, then launch ONE gate reviewer (never a panel) to audit goal, constraints, code quality, security, missed context, and QA evidence. Use before a PR handoff or when the user explicitly asks to review completed work.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在代码交付前跑一遍人工验收与质量审查,给出是否可提交的结论
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你刚完成一批工作,想在交付或发起 PR 前确认质量与风险都过关
copy.tagline_en: Run acceptance and quality review before shipping to confirm readiness
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you've finished a batch of work and want quality and risk checked before handoff

howto.what: 实现完成后，它会自己在真实界面上跑一遍手动 QA 并留下证据，再只派一个 gate reviewer 子代理，对照目标、约束、代码质量、安全、遗漏上下文和 QA 证据做审查；QA 无失败行且审查返回 APPROVE 才算通过。
howto.when: 在把改动交给 PR 前，或你明确要求审查已完成的工作时触发；它先自己跑手动 QA，再启动单个 gate reviewer。

say.text: 帮我 review 这次实现，看能不能提 PR
say.note: 先跑手动 QA，再启动单个 gate reviewer

say.text: 跑一遍这次改动的 QA 并做 gate review
say.note: 有失败行会直接判 REVIEW FAILED

say.text: 只针对这次 diff 审安全和代码质量
say.note: 只用一个 reviewer，不开评审团

howto.what_en: After implementation it runs manual QA on the real surface itself, capturing evidence, then launches exactly one gate reviewer (never a panel) to audit goal, constraints, code quality, security, missed context and QA evidence.
howto.when_en: Triggered before handing a change off to a PR, or when you explicitly ask to review completed work; it starts with the skill's own manual QA, then one gate reviewer.

say_en.text: Review this implementation and tell me if it's ready for a PR
say_en.note: Runs manual QA first, then one gate reviewer

say_en.text: Run QA on this change and gate-review it
say_en.note: A failing QA row ends in REVIEW FAILED

say_en.text: Gate-review this diff for security and code quality
